question: Were you totally blind on December 31, 2025, or do you have a statement certified by your eye doctor (ophthalmologist or optometrist) that you can't see better than 20/200 in your better eye with glasses or contact lenses, or that your field of vision is 20 degrees or less? If your eye condition isn't likely to improve beyond the conditions listed above, you can get a statement certified by your eye doctor (ophthalmologist or optometrist) to this effect instead.
